question: Who enjoys the power to summon, prorogue either house of Indian Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**President.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• The power to summon and prorogue either House of Parliament or to dissolve the Lok Sabha vests with the President.
 
• The Indian Constitution provides that the Parliament shall consist of the President
